decision.scope_statement: The private candidate is acceptable for this bounded source-only monitor repair and for a subsequent exact request/invocation review. It is not approval to edit the canonical wrapper, run native controls, admit a run, retry, or claim a qualified or clean run.

command_before_native.detail: The candidate obtains executor._process_table() before proc.process_table(); the later native table is the only table used for ancestry extension and exact-birth row ownership.

unchanged_ancestry_helper.detail: proc.descendants(native, tracked) remains the frozen helper and admits a descendant only through a parent whose current native birth matches the tracked birth.

exact_birth_own_row_filter.detail: A command row is removed only when its PID is in the augmented tracked map, present in the same later native table, and its native birth equals the tracked birth.

outer_tracked_merge.detail: supervise() assigns snapshot.tracked_after before contender handling, so every exact-birth descendant admitted by the join is retained for later polling and owned-only cleanup.

frozen_classifiers.detail: The existing executor and hashed-Bifrost classifiers remain the only semantic contender checks after ownership filtering; no argv/path exemption or PID-only suppression was added.

public_list_api.detail: contenders() retains its list return contract and raises the original probe error instead of treating a failed native probe as an empty list.

receipt_and_primary_error.detail: A contention or command/native probe failure attempts immutable contention-stop.json before raising; a receipt write failure is attached as a note while preserving the original primary error and automatic_retry=false.

cleanup_and_containment.detail: Cleanup remains exact-birth owned-only and the return value retains descendant_containment=polling-unknown-even-if-no-tracked-survivors.

no canonical source edit and no Git mutation

near_miss_review.detail: The candidate does not widen ownership based on command text, path, PID alone, or a missing native row. A native probe error is fail-closed and attempts a receipt; no automatic retry or defer path was introduced.

explicit_limits: Command rows contain no birth identity. Ownership is correlated from a command snapshot to one later native snapshot, so this preserves the existing two-snapshot polling identity boundary and is not an atomic command-row/native join.

Exact native birth matching and tracked parent comparison reduce PID reuse and reparenting ambiguity but do not establish complete containment or prove that a historical offender caused a run failure.
The candidate's polling result must retain descendant_containment=polling-unknown-even-if-no-tracked-survivors; an empty survivor list is not containment proof.
No historical ownership inference, qualification inference, or clean-result inference is permitted from this candidate or its receipt.

followups.finding: The immutable receipt path is explicit for command/native process-table errors and classified contention, but proc.descendants() and the two frozen classifier calls occur outside the try/diagnostic path at native_qualifier.py:588-613. If either helper raises after snapshots are obtained, supervise() records the primary failure without attempting contention-stop.json.
followups.minimal_clarification: Before canonical integration, either wrap these post-snapshot phases in the same structured diagnostic path or state that receipt availability is guaranteed only for process-table and classified-contention failures; preserve the primary error either way.

review_statement: The candidate meets the approved commands-first/native-after, exact-birth, outer-tracked, unchanged-classifier, fail-closed and immutable-receipt design within the existing polling boundary. I found no blocker to this bounded private source review. The candidate remains monitor-only and publication/runtime held, and the explicit polling and historical-attribution limits above must remain in any handoff or receipt interpretation.
